_doc: Simulated Smart Tagging v2 (cache_tags_v2). Structure matched to label-free aggregates of the TARGET's Smart Tagging (an input feature, not GT) relayed by decoder-7d from the captain: fixed set-piece windows (35 s; kickoffs 5 s, tag start 3.5 s before kickoff), ~30 set-piece tags per half, 32/59 set pieces without team, long attacking-phase windows (CREATING CHANCES 30 s exact, BUILD UP ~20 s, PROGRESSION ~18 s, ATTACKING TRANSITION ~15 s, others median 12-30 s) running across turnovers, attacking-phase coverage ~0.69 one team / ~0.075 both / rest none. Per-code relative counts from DATA.md. Defending mirror rows are not emitted (decoder ignores them). Unspecified lengths and all noise are ASSUMPTIONS.
_phase_len_s: median length; CREATING CHANCES fixed; others multiplied by U(1-len_spread, 1+len_spread). LONG BALL / BALL IN FINAL THIRD / BALL IN THE BOX lengths are assumptions inside the reported 12-30 s range.
_phase_count_per_match: DATA.md counts (relative density per code); scaled per half by k, bisected so the share of frames with no attacking-phase tag = target_none.
_sp_extra_n: throw-ins are always N (~40% of restarts); extra N on other set pieces 0.23 brings the N share to ~0.54 = 32/59 on the target.
